tenderSchedule.title: ALL INDIA TOUR OF STUDENTS OF UAS DHARWAD FOR 2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: Outsourcing the services of Luxury buses for local transport at different places on hire basis and accommodation to the students of UAS Dharwad on All India Tour. (11 batches)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender documents annexed

The vendors shall refer to the batch-wise tour itinerary, local transport plan, halt and fresh-up schedules, rooms required, tour schedule and tour programme and quote rates accordingly. Any doubts in this regard may be clarified and quote accordingly
The rates quoted shall be inclusive of all taxes, levies, GST etc
Refer to the revised tour schedule enclosed (if any)
The annual Turn over certificates issued by Chartered Accountant must have UDIN number for verification

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency /Service provider should have conducted Educational tour / conducted educational package tours for not less than 300 students in any one year in last five years (i.e- 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026,). Enclose certificate issued in this regard by the Head of the Institution of Government / Semi Government / Quasi Government / Autonomous bodies. (Certificates issued by private organizations will not be considered) The certificates are to be notarized. Non production of notarized documents shall entail disqualification.

Enclose consolidated certificate by the Chartered Accountant for having achieved a annual turnover of Rs. 20.00 Lakhs in any one year in preceding five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2026,. The certificates are to be notarized. Non production of notarized documents shall entail disqualification.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall enclose copy valid tours and travels agency trade license issued by competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid Trade licence  issued by competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Provide declaration about legal status of the company, that the company is not involved in any legal disputes with the employer (UAS Dharwad) or any other organization. The bids of the vendor will not be accepted failing to submit the information under this clause.
Enclose IT Returns Acknowledgement for the years 2024-2025, 2023-24, 2022-23 (For Assessment years 2025-2026, 2024-25, 2023-24
